Dear Group Members

Your guidance is urgently required. 

I have a dataset, where data is collected from 40 teams. Each team has around 4 to 5 members.

Now the model is simple, with 3 mediators, 1 IV, and 1 DV.

My Strategy is
Within and Between Group Analysis using Lavaan.

Is it right way to do it?
Mplus has an option called Complexity, Anything similar in Lavaan

Kind Suggest?

Regards
Fawad

messages.author: 5b9c62b1c7cbc1e6
messages.subject: Re: Data Analysis for group Data
parts:
Fawad,

The "cluster" argument in lavaan() is, as far as I know, equivalent to the "complex" statement in Mplus. In both cases, it estimate relations among level-1 variables, adjusting for clustering.

If you are interested in relations among level-2 (between) variables, I'm pretty sure lavaan doesn't do that yet.

Pat
